patterns.note: Content is primarily centered with generous vertical spacing, creating an airy and focused presentation for each section.
A large, elegant serif font is used for primary headings, contrasting with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and smaller labels.
A minimalist palette features a dominant light beige background, dark charcoal text, and subtle lighter beige for card surfaces, maintaining a sophisticated and understated feel.

As the user scrolls down, the initial top-aligned name disappears, and a full-body image of the designer scrolls into view from the top of the viewport, settling above the main hero heading. This image then remains prominently positioned above the heading for a significant scroll depth, creating a dynamic, personal introduction.

Key information is presented in distinct, well-separated sections: a personal hero, experience cards, a visual 'Snapshots' gallery, and an 'About' text block, each clearly delineated by ample whitespace.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a scroll-triggered reveal where a full-body image of the designer appears from the top of the viewport, replacing the initial text header. This image then becomes a sticky element, remaining above the main heading as the rest of the page content scrolls up, creating a personal and engaging introduction.
The site uses a full-bleed, light-colored background that provides a clean canvas for the centered content, enhancing readability and giving a premium feel.
Experience cards feature subtle rounded corners and a slightly lighter background color than the main page, providing a soft visual distinction without harsh borders.

design_tokens.type_scale: large, elegant serif hero heading (~3x body) with clean sans-serif body text and smaller uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounded corners on cards and image containers.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and balanced spacing within content blocks.

standout: The distinctive scroll-triggered reveal of the designer's full-body image, which then acts as a sticky, personal header, immediately establishes a unique and engaging connection. This, combined with the minimalist aesthetic and impactful typography, elevates the site beyond a standard portfolio.
